title: Make non-permeable calendar walls hard constraints

root_cause.boundary: app/sequence.py::validate_sequence (backend soft warnings) + frontend/src/model/overflow.ts (wall-blind overflow placement)
root_cause.mechanism: backend emitted calendar-block overlaps as soft unexpected_overlap acceptable defects (T18d/LD26), so a model-placed row over Cooking validated clean; frontend overflowRows laid dropped rows from the anchor with no wall awareness, so Magic Mirror could be staged over Cooking at 20:30 and the exact shape the server then hard-rejects was generated client-side

backend_production: app/sequence.py: calendar-sourced anchored blocks (source == calendar) with capacity_class fixed/work and no overlap_allowed, no window Type, not ignored/quarantined are now calendar_spans; overlap hard-rejects with a deterministic hard error naming the block and interval
app/sequence.py: calendar wall overlap in the overflow tail is also hard (explicit infeasibility, not G16 overflow_overlap softness) — only config-backed blocks and movable work keep soft readings
app/sequence.py: ignored/quarantined calendar rows are no wall at all (frozen contract 17: excluded from planning) via _CALENDAR_EXCLUDED_CLASSES
app/main.py::_judged_anchored: quarantined calendar rows dropped alongside ignored rows so the judgment prompt never sees a row that would otherwise harden silently
Exact overlap grants still downgrade a calendar wall overlap to allowed_overlap (soft info); window blocks and permeable overlap_allowed blocks unchanged
frontend_production: frontend/src/model/overflow.ts: new calendarWalls(anchored) helper — kind calendar, not ignored, on, attending, not overlapAllowed, with a real interval

frontend/src/model/overflow.ts: overflowRows accepts walls and skips them — a row that would intersect a wall moves to just after it; rows that cannot fit before a wall running to end of day are omitted; rows still never overlap each other

frontend/src/store/controller.ts: autoSequence passes calendarWalls(effectiveAnchoredBlocks(post)) so Day-Setup dismissals free their interval and overflow never stages the calendar-wall overlap the server hard-rejects
fix.no_store_change: frontend/src/store/store.ts::acceptableDefects needs no change — a calendar wall overlap is now a backend hard error (never a warning), and overflow avoids generating one client-side

regression_tests.behavior: fixed and work class calendar blocks hard-reject overlap; unidentified calendar defaults to hard wall; ignored/quarantined rows are no wall; exact grant keeps allowed_overlap; overflow-tail calendar overlap is hard; config-backed blocks keep LD26 acceptable-defect softness; no-overlap still passes
regression_tests.red_before_fix: 6 failed before the fix: hard-wall tests returned ok=True with unexpected_overlap warnings; ignored-row test emitted a soft warning

regression_tests.behavior: POST /sequence with a quarantined calendar block must not hand it to the judgment payload (contract 17); red before fix (block leaked into captured anchored)

regression_tests.test: overflowRows wall avoidance (5 tests) + calendarWalls (3 tests)
regression_tests.behavior: overflow skips a wall interval and continues after it; a straddling row moves after the wall; anchor inside a wall jumps past; wall to midnight omits rows; rows stay mutually non-overlapping; calendarWalls selects only on/attending/non-ignored calendar rows with real intervals
mocked autoSequence drops six included rows so overflow runs from the 07:30 anchor across the 09:15-09:45 Trinoor Standup wall; asserts every overflow row avoids every effective calendar wall

safety_proof.live_post_sequence_adjust_commit: none — all backend tests are unit tests with fakes; no adapter call reaches a live endpoint
safety_proof.branch_or_index_mutation: none — no commit, stage, reset, clean, stash, rebase, or merge
safety_proof.foreign_changes_preserved: tracked dirty work (.gitignore, AGENTS.md, README.md, gem-team.yaml, .opencode, docs/plan extraction plan.yaml) untouched; edited files live in untracked app/ and frontend/ dirs, same as FEEDBACK-01

out_of_scope_noted: event classification changes (FF-CAL-01/FF-06) — quarantined frontend projection still maps to fixed, unchanged
store.ts acceptableDefects unchanged — verified no calendar-wall finding belongs there
